purpose: Refine the only coarse-sweep positive region (-0.5/-0.25) with fresh asymmetric pairs. This stage selects at most one fixed finalist; it cannot promote H9.

fixed_stack.authority: synchronous Tetrp TL with authority-validated reset-safe placement transport

grid_reason: The repaired coarse sweep found the only positive-direction plateau at -0.5 and -0.25.
The refinement keeps both plateau anchors, inserts -0.375 between them, and samples one shoulder on each side (-0.625 and -0.125).
The range stays local rather than spending refinement budget on the clearly poor positive-sign region.

sampling.common_random_numbers: Every H9 refinement value uses the same 40 fresh asymmetric seed pairs.
sampling.pair_design: Game A candidate gets seed X in slot0 and incumbent seed Y in slot1; Game B swaps profile assignment so candidate gets seed Y in slot1.
sampling.independence: The 40 asymmetric pairs are the experimental units; 80 games are not 80 independent observations.

integrity_gates: Every value must have 40 complete asymmetric pairs / 80 scored games with no harness failures.
Each pair must contain candidate once in slot0 and once in slot1.
The one-lock placement-transport guard must remain enabled.
Any correctness failure blocks finalist selection until repaired; do not count a malformed game as a loss.

finalist_selection.eligibility: A value must have positive net paired sweeps and >40/80 candidate KO wins.
tie_breakers: smaller absolute distance from -0.375 (the center of the coarse positive plateau)
finalist_selection.boundary_rule: If the selected best value is -0.625 or -0.125, extend refinement outward on that side with fresh seeds before fixing a finalist.
finalist_selection.no_positive_region: If no value meets eligibility, pause H9 rather than force a finalist.
finalist_selection.no_promotion: Local refinement can select a finalist only. It cannot promote H9.

next_if_finalist_selected: Preregister one fixed H9 finalist against corrected_legacy_h12 for roughly 200 fresh asymmetric pairs / 400 games. Promotion requires that independent confirmation.
